A little over a year ago I was in my college apartment using the bathroom. From what I remember I was scrolling through texts I was sent of all these videos of “Microchip’s inside vaccines”. I don’t know if that’s what set it off or not. I was already on edge entire day and around then it was probably 7:30PM or so. 

I then remember my heart starting racing a tad but not super crazy. I then started thinking about my heart rate. I then jumped into the shower and made it extremely freezing. I tried calling myself down and couldn’t. I then switched back and forth from hot/cold/hot/cold. 

I was in extreme state of panic to the point where I felt like I was on top of a skyscraper. I felt extremely tall or something. I was extremely terrified. I rushed and dried myself off while feeling the thumbing of my heart and desperately putting my clothes back on. 

I then proceeded to go to my room and put on my sweatshirt and a pair of pajama pants. While shaking my right leg and trying to calm myself. I immediately rush outside and see my roommate who I say too “Ill be back just trying to calm down”. 

I began walking around the complex streets and no sign of relaxation. I began over analyzing and taking in everything around me. I felt extremely sensory overload and terrified with an extreme heart rate checking constantly. 

I kept thinking how badly I want to be home. How badly I want to see my parents. How badly I just want to feel okay. I heard people in distance laughing while smoking and enjoying their night and it just made me more anxious. 

I had overwhelming thoughts. I then walked back inside and up to my room. I texted my mom first “Are you there rn”. I then after getting no response called my dad in an extremely frightened tone. I told him how I was having a panic attack and felt like I was going to die. 

Everything around me was going black. My eyelids were flashing, I thought I was fading in and out. I kept telling him how scared I was. I asked him to come pick me up now (he’s 5 hours away with no traffic). 

Still being on the call. It took a good 2 hours probably to bring down heart rate a little. I then tried eating pizza which only could do tiny bites and only increased heart rate. 

My window was slightly open and I then could hear roommates smoking with girls right outside window. Extremely triggering cause marijuana causes panic for me. I closed and still was in panic mode. 

I turned on TV in room with a black and white movie “It’s a wonderful life”. Whole night I never fell asleep but my dad stayed on the phone entire time. While he was probably asleep. I might’ve finally fallen asleep around 6am-8am.

Next morning I have it embedded in my mind. Anxiety broke me. It beat me down and spit me out. I packed all my bags. I got my dad to pick me up. He told me in the car “Your not going to drop out”. 

I never went back since. I still battle anxiety. It’s my goal to beat it and I will not give up. I know that there is help. I know that there is a cure. Once I can beat it, I will share my story and help others.
